# Microsoft Support

> > Official Microsoft support hub providing help, troubleshooting, and customer service for Windows, Microsoft 365, Office, and all Microsoft products and services.

Microsoft Support serves as the central resource for technical assistance, account management, and product documentation across the entire Microsoft ecosystem. The site covers everything from Windows 11 upgrades and system recovery to Microsoft 365 subscriptions, account security, and direct customer service contact options.

## Key Topics

- Windows 11
- Windows 10
- Microsoft 365
- Microsoft account
- Office applications (Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, OneNote, Access)
- OneDrive
- Windows Update
- Account management and recovery
- Troubleshooting
- Customer support and contact options
- Business support and admin center
- Account security
- Subscription management
- System upgrades and migration

## Support & Contact

- [Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us): Main support hub for Microsoft products including Copilot and Windows 11
- [Contact Us - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/contactus): Contact Microsoft Support for help with Microsoft 365, Office, and more
- [Customer service phone numbers - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/topic/customer-service-phone-numbers-c0389ade-5640-e588-8b0e-28de8afeb3f2): Support phone numbers for business users and regional contact info
- [Microsoft 365 Customer Service and Support - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/microsoft-365-customer-service-and-support-96162163-b3aa-498b-bbbb-5e757b0f31da): Microsoft 365 support policy for home and business subscriptions
- [All Products](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/all-products): Directory of all Microsoft products with support links

## Account Management

- [Account help](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/account): Microsoft account setup, security, and subscription management help
- [Get help with your Microsoft account - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/account-billing/get-help-with-your-microsoft-account-ace6f3b3-e2d3-aeb1-6b96-d2e9e7e52133): Troubleshoot Microsoft account sign-in, security, and billing issues

## Windows Help & Learning

- [Windows help and learning](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows): Windows 11 and 10 help center with Copilot and AI features guide
- [Welcome To Windows](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/welcometowindows): Windows 11 upgrade guide with FAQs and device lifecycle info
- [Install Windows Updates - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/install-windows-updates-3c5ae7fc-9fb6-9af1-1984-b5e0412c556a): Check and install Windows 11/10 updates for security and performance
- [Recovery Drive - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/recovery-drive-abb4691b-5324-6d4a-8766-73fab304c246): Create USB recovery drive for Windows 11/10 system restore
- [Uninstall or remove apps and programs in Windows - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/uninstall-or-remove-apps-and-programs-in-windows-4b55f974-2cc6-2d2b-d092-5905080eaf98): Remove apps and programs using Windows Settings or Control Panel

## Optional

- [Get Help for Microsoft personal account users - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/get-help-for-microsoft-personal-account-users-aaf7f74b-026e-489b-a102-0570dfbfb192): Using Windows Get Help app with Microsoft personal accounts
- [Converting documents to a newer format - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/converting-documents-to-a-newer-format-34ec742e-f0f9-4d95-bbe3-3ee8e30a86fa): Convert Word documents to newer formats for latest features
